_provenance.description: Vendored rule-id vocabulary for granular policy validation failures matching SPEC §8 rules.
_provenance.status: hand-listed pending contract-level granular validation issue; swap-in point documented

rules.description: Policy object or property has wrong primitive or structural type.
Required policy field is missing, null, or undefined.
Address string does not decode to a valid Stellar strkey.
Amounts, caps, durations, or timestamps are negative (< 0).
window_cap != 0 requires window_secs != 0.
A per-recipient cap > 0 requires window_secs != 0.
active_until must be 0 (never expires) or strictly greater than active_from.
Assets, recipients (with allow_any_recipient false), or protocols list is empty.
Duplicate addresses within assets list are rejected.
Duplicate addresses within recipients list are rejected.
Duplicate addresses within blocked_recipients list are rejected.
Duplicate contract addresses within protocols list are rejected.
Duplicate function names in a protocol rule fns list are rejected.
Protocol rule fns list is an empty array; use null to allow any function.
Duplicate recipients within recipient_window_caps are rejected.
Recipient lists exceed MAX_RECIPIENT_ENTRIES (256).
Address appears in both recipients and blocked_recipients.
The contract's own address cannot appear in assets.
The contract's own address cannot appear in protocols.
The contract's own address cannot appear in recipients or blocked_recipients.
The contract's own address cannot appear in recipient_window_caps.
